summary: McDowell County, WV platform tower that the FFLA files under non-lookout structures and marks gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone and filed under non-lookout structures by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: listed under non-lookout structures, not lookouts
Eastern US lookouts page places Coalwood in McDowell County
no description of remains or visitor access (status only)

notes_for_editor: Both sources are thin. The FFLA list puts Coalwood under Non-lookout Structures, so it may not be a fire lookout at all; the record kind 'platform' follows that list. The Eastern page has only the name and county. A topographic-map site (anyplaceamerica.com) calls it a 'Coalwood Lookout Tower' but gives no history, so it was not used. Record coordinates match the FFLA list. Editor should decide whether Coalwood belongs on the map as a lookout.
